metric_definitions.subscribers: Public rounded channel subscribers at the dated snapshot
metric_definitions.lifetime_views: Cumulative public channel views, NOT latest-month views
metric_definitions.video_count: Public upload/video count at snapshot; can include different formats
metric_definitions.recent_views: Third-party rolling-window channel views; null when not reliably sourced
metric_definitions.reference_video_views: Single video's cumulative public views at tracker snapshot, if available
metric_definitions.data_warning: YouTube changed channel viewCount counting on 2026-08-24 and Shorts public views counting on 2025-03-31. Channel ages, format mixes, and counting methodology differ.

channels.name: Llama Arts

channels.name: Wasted Series

channels.name: vewn
channels.analyst_note: High views-per-upload historical signal but labor-intensive auteur artistry is hard to automate without losing the appeal.
